DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りはどのような方法ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How will you take it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車です。かごへ横に寝かせれば、包装があるので大丈夫だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装付き花束を自転車かごで横置きする予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: By bicycle. I thought that since it's wrapped, it would be fine laid sideways in the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to place a wrapped bouquet sideways in a bicycle basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 包装だけで、どの向きでも運べるとは限りません。花束の状態と運び方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Wrapping alone doesn't mean it can be carried in any direction. We'll check the bouquet's condition and carrying method.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 包みを見て判断していました。保水している部分の向きも含めて、運び方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 包装と運搬適性を分け保水部も含む説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I judged from the wrapping. Please explain how to carry it, including the orientation of the water-holding part.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish wrapping from suitability for transport and request an explanation including the water-holding section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この花束は担当が持ち方を示します。かごへ押し込めるかを先に試さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will demonstrate how to hold this bouquet. Please don't first try forcing it into the basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 押し込みません。かごの大きさでは余裕がないので、自転車でそのまま運ぶ予定を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 押し込まず自転車運搬を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't force it. The basket has no spare room, so I'd like to change my plan to carry it straight home by bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not force it into the basket; reconsider bicycle transport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取り方法を変える場合は、保管や受取り時刻を確認します。別の方法は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you change the collection method, we'll check storage and collection time. Have you decided on another method?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自転車を家へ置いて、歩いて戻れるか考えています。預かってもらえると決めず条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩再来店を検討し預かり条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm considering leaving the bicycle at home and walking back. I don't want to assume you'll hold it; I'd like to ask the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider returning on foot and ask about holding conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が本日の預かり条件を案内します。花束はここに置いたまま確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain today's holding conditions. Let's check while leaving the bouquet here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。預かりの条件が合えば受取りを変え、戻った時に教わった向きで手に持って運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預かり可否確認後に受取変更と教わった向きでの運搬を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. If the holding conditions work, I'll change collection and carry it by hand in the direction you teach me when I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm whether holding is possible before changing collection and deciding to carry it in the demonstrated orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当に確認します。持ち方と受取り方法を一緒にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check with the person in charge. We'll explain holding and collection together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のどの案内についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which parcel information would you like advice about?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙を見て再配達を頼みに来ました。不在だったので、荷物は郵便局へ戻ったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在案内を再配達と思い郵便局へ戻ったと解釈したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to request redelivery after seeing this paper. I was out, so I thought the parcel had gone back to the post office.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you interpreted an absence notice as requiring redelivery and meaning the parcel returned to the post office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙には宅配ボックスへ配達したとあります。ご自宅のボックスは確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This paper says it was delivered to a parcel locker. Have you checked the locker at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。配達済みとあっても、私が手元で受け取ったわけではありません。まず置かれた場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達済みと本人受取を区別しボックス位置確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Even if it says delivered, I haven't received it in my hands. I'd first like to check where it was placed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish delivered status from personal receipt and ask to check the locker location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ボックス番号と開けるための案内があります。お問い合わせ番号とは別の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a locker number and opening guidance. Those are separate fields from the inquiry number.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追跡用の番号を入力しようとしていました。ボックスの番号と開け方の案内を分けて読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡番号とボックス番号と開け方を読み分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was about to enter the tracking number. I'll read the locker number and opening instructions separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the tracking number, locker number, and opening instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の荷物について指定されたボックスだけを確認してください。開けられなければ、その状態をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check only the locker specified for your own parcel. If you can't open it, tell us that situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号が読みにくいので、近くの別のボックスで試しません。建物の管理担当にも、開け方を確認する必要があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不鮮明な番号で別ボックスを試さず設備担当への確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number is hard to read, so I won't try a different nearby locker. I'd also like to ask whether I need to check opening instructions with the building manager.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not try another locker using an unclear number; request a check with the equipment manager. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 機械の操作は管理担当への確認が必要です。配送については、配達記録を担当へ照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Machine operation needs checking with management. For delivery, you can ask the delivery staff about the delivery record.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではこの紙を残し、指定のボックスと操作案内を確認します。開けられない場合は、配送記録と設備の操作をそれぞれの担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を保持し配送記録と設備操作の相談先を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll keep this paper and check the specified locker and instructions. If I can't open it, I'll consult the respective people about the delivery record and equipment operation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the instructions and distinguish contacts for delivery records and equipment operation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今は再配達の申し込みとして処理せず、配達先のボックス情報を確認する相談として引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't process this as a redelivery request now; we'll pass it on as a consultation about the destination locker information.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 積み込みは、青い車から白い車へ変更します。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll change loading from the blue vehicle to the white one.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白い車は別の方面へ行く印象がありました。箱の宛先も白い車に合わせて書き直すのですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車両変更で荷物宛先も直すのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I associated the white vehicle with a different direction. Should I rewrite the boxes' destinations to match it too?
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether changing vehicles also means changing parcel destinations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回は車両の変更です。荷物の配送先を変更する指示ではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a vehicle change. It isn't an instruction to change the cargo's delivery destinations.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。ラベルは触らず、変更された車両の番号を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配送先は維持し当日の車両番号確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll leave the labels untouched and would like to check the replacement vehicle's number.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Keep the delivery destinations and request confirmation of today's vehicle number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが当日の割当です。箱数と配送先の照合も、積み込み担当と行ってください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is today's assignment. Also compare the box count and destinations with the loading staff.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十二箱とあります。隣の便の二箱を加えるのでなく、この便の十二箱だけ確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当該便十二箱を隣便の荷物と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says twelve boxes. Rather than add the two from the neighboring service, I'll check only this service's twelve.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish this service's twelve boxes from the neighboring service's cargo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。運転者が着いたら、便の番号で照合します。車体の色だけで載せないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. When the driver arrives, we'll match the service number. Don't load based only on vehicle color.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ積みません。白い車が二台あっても、当日の便番号と合った方へ担当の指示で運びます。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車色でなく便番号と担当指示で積むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't load yet. Even if there are two white vehicles, I'll take the boxes to the one matching today's service number under the staff's instructions.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will load by service number and staff instructions rather than vehicle color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認は私が一緒に行います。元の車へ運びかけた荷物はありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with you. Is there any cargo you had started taking to the original vehicle?

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 台車に二箱ありますが、車内には入れていません。十二箱のうちの二箱として場所を報告します。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未積込二箱は十二箱の一部として所在を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are two boxes on the cart, but I haven't put them in the vehicle. I'll report their location as two of the twelve.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the location of two unloaded boxes as part of the twelve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その状態から確認しましょう。ラベルと便番号を照合して積み込みます。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check from that state. We'll compare labels and service number before loading.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの券は、別の路線の一日券ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a day pass for another line.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一日乗れる券なので、モノレールも同じ日に使えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一日有効なら他交通機関でも使えると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since it's a ticket valid for a whole day, I thought I could use it on the monorail that day too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought one-day validity meant other transport was included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付の有効範囲と、使える交通機関は別です。券の対象路線をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The valid date and usable transport systems are separate. Please check which lines the ticket covers.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 路面電車と書いてあります。今日という条件だけ見て、路線の欄を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 有効日と対象路線を区別して表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says tram. I looked only at today's date condition and overlooked the line field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish valid date from covered line and check the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習場面では、モノレールの利用には別の券が必要です。目的地はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this learning situation, a separate ticket is needed for the monorail. Where is your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 港駅です。路面電車の券を捨てて買い直すのでなく、二つを別に保管したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的地と別券保管の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Minato Station. Rather than throw away the tram ticket and buy a replacement, I'd like to keep the two separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the destination and your wish to keep separate tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: モノレールの区間券をご案内します。路面電車の券は、その対象内で使えるか別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain a monorail section ticket. Check separately whether the tram ticket is usable within its coverage.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。帰りに路面電車を使う予定です。モノレール購入で一日券も新しくなるとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別交通券の購入が既存券更新ではないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I plan to take the tram back. I won't assume buying a monorail ticket also renews the day pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand that buying another transport ticket does not renew the existing ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この区間券でモノレールに乗ることをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to use this section ticket for the monorail?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日の一日券と区間券を取り違えず、使う路線に合った方を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 路線ごとに適切な券を出すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. I won't mix up today's day pass and section ticket; I'll present the one matching the line I'm using.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will show the appropriate ticket for each line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: モノレールの券はこちらです。対象の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the monorail ticket. Please check its coverage.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取り寄せ品のお受け取りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're collecting an ordered-in item, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙に別の店名があります。そちらの店で払った扱いで、今日は受け取るだけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出荷元店名を支払済み記録と解釈したと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This paper has another shop's name. Does it mean payment was handled there and I'm just collecting today?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about interpreting the supplying shop's name as a payment record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その店名は在庫のある出荷元です。支払いの記録ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That shop is the shipping source with the stock. It isn't a payment record.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 取寄せを頼む時に代金は渡していませんでした。店名があるので、会計が済んだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼時は未払いだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I hadn't paid when requesting it. Because the shop name was there, I thought payment was complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you had not paid when requesting the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では受け取り店で会計します。商品を見てから購入を決めるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, payment is at the collection shop. Would you like to decide whether to buy after seeing the item?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。届いたサイズと色を確認したいです。取り寄せの依頼だけで必ず買う条件だったかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品確認と取寄せ時の購入条件の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to check the delivered size and color. Please also tell me whether requesting the transfer meant I was obliged to buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request an item check and an explanation of the purchase conditions when ordering it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご依頼時の条件を照合します。この場面では確認後に購入を決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll compare the conditions from your request. In this situation, you can decide to purchase after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。出荷元へ勝手に連絡して返品するのではなく、この店で選び方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出荷元へ自己返品せず受取店で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Rather than contact the source shop and return it myself, I'll discuss choosing it at this shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will consult the collection shop rather than independently return it to the source. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届いた商品はこちらです。ご希望のサイズと合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the item that arrived. Does it match your preferred size?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合っています。こちらで払って購入します。出荷元の名前を支払い場所と混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した商品を受取店で支払って購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll pay and buy it here. I'll make sure not to confuse the shipping-source name with the payment location.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy the checked item and pay at the collection shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。この店での購入記録をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll give you a purchase record from this shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 焼く時の用具について、ご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like guidance on the grilling utensils?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。私が焼いた肉の横に友人が新しい肉を置き、どれがいつ置かれたか分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追加肉と先に置いた肉が混ざり順序が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend placed new meat beside the meat I'd been grilling, and now we can't tell which was put down when.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that newly added meat mixed with earlier meat and the order is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 状態を見分けたつもりで召し上がらず、担当へ相談してください。まだ食べていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't eat it assuming you can tell its condition; consult the staff. You haven't eaten any yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食べていません。私が最初に置いた三枚と、友人が後から置いた二枚が混ざっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未食で先三枚と後二枚の経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The three slices I put down first and the two my friend added later are mixed together.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is uneaten and explain the three earlier and two later slices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経緯を確認します。用具も、生の肉を扱うものと分ける案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check that history. There are also instructions to separate utensils from those used for raw meat.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ用具を使ってよいとは決めず、担当の説明を聞きたいです。新しい肉を追加するのはいったん止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用具の使い分けを確認し追加を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume the same utensil is acceptable; I'd like the staff's explanation. I'll stop adding new meat for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check separate utensil use and stop adding meat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当がこちらで状態と用具の扱いをご案内します。色だけで置いた順番を判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the food's state and utensils here. Don't judge the placement order from color alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人へも、追加した二枚の位置を覚えているか聞きます。私の記憶を友人の操作の記録にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色や自己記憶で同行者の操作を断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll also ask my friend whether they remember the positions of the two they added. I won't treat my memory as a record of my friend's actions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not assert your companion's actions based on color or your own memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かる範囲をお伝えください。確認するまで料理の状態を変えずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell us as far as you know. Please wait without changing the food's condition until we check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。五枚の経緯と用具の使い方を確認してから、担当の案内で食事を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現状態で担当確認を受けてから食事を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check the history of the five slices and utensil use before continuing the meal with the staff's guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the staff's check in the current state before continuing the meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びました。お二人で説明をお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've called the staff. Please both listen to the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前の列は、水がかかる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The front rows may get splashed with water.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は後ろへ座りますが、かばんは前の空席へ置いても大丈夫ですか。席があれば濡れないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 後列に自分だけ座り前列へ荷物を残す案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll sit at the back, but may I leave my bag on an empty front seat? I thought a seat would keep it dry.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss sitting at the back yourself while leaving luggage in front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空席でも水がかかる可能性はあります。お荷物もご自身の席へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even an empty seat may get splashed. Please take your belongings to your own seat too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。人が座っていないことと、乾いた場所ということは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空席と水がかからない場所を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. An unoccupied seat and a dry place are different things.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish an empty seat from a place protected from splashes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。後方でも濡れない保証ではありません。濡れて困る物は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Even at the back, we don't guarantee dryness. What belongings would be a problem if wet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類です。袋の口を閉じて自分で持ちます。後ろへ移るだけで十分とは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類を袋へ収め後列も乾燥保証ではないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Documents. I'll close the bag and hold it myself. I won't assume moving to the back alone is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put documents in a bag and understand that the rear rows do not guarantee dryness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動する時は、通路や他のお客様の視界をふさがないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When moving, please don't block the passage or other visitors' view.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。開始前に友人と荷物をまとめて移ります。途中で前の席へ取りに戻らない計画にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始前に人と荷物を移し途中回収を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My friend and I will gather our belongings and move before it starts. We'll plan not to return to the front seats for them midway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move people and belongings before the start and avoid retrieving them midway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 後方の空いている席をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you empty seats toward the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二人分の席と荷物を一緒に移し、書類の袋も閉じてから見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の席と荷物を同時に移して鑑賞する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. We'll move both people's seating and belongings together and close the document bag before watching.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Move both people's seats and luggage together before watching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの席です。荷物は周囲の通行を妨げない位置へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the seats. Put belongings somewhere they won't obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 請求の使用量についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about billed usage?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。メーターは四百と表示されていますが、紙の使用量は二十です。少なく書かれているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 累積表示と請求使用量の不一致を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The meter shows four hundred, but the paper's usage is twenty. Has it been written too low?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a mismatch between a cumulative meter reading and billed usage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メーターの表示と、期間内の使用量は別に確認します。請求の検針日は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the meter display separately from usage during a period. Can you read the meter-reading date on the bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週です。私が四百を見たのは今日なので、測った日も同じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自身の確認日と検針日は異なると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last week. I saw four hundred today, so the measurement dates aren't the same either.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that your checking date and the official meter-reading date differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前回と今回の検針記録を担当が照合します。ご自身で差額の金額を計算して支払う話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will compare the previous and current meter records. This isn't a matter of calculating a difference in money yourself and paying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日の累積表示を今月一回の使用量として、金額を増やして払わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 累積値で支払額を自己修正しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't treat today's cumulative display as this month's single-period usage and increase the payment myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not adjust payment yourself using the cumulative value. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 請求書と、今日確認した日時をお知らせください。表示の写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please provide the bill and the date and time you checked today. Do you have a display photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。小数の部分も写っていますが、その数字の読み方まで自分で決めず、写真のまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日時付き原写真を示し小数の読みを推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. It includes the decimal part too, but I won't even decide how to read those digits myself; I'll show the photo as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the original photo with its date and time without guessing the decimal reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。いまの請求の扱いも確認結果と一緒にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass this to the person in charge. We'll explain how the current bill is handled along with the check's result.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二つの日付と表示と使用量を分け、正しい記録の説明を受けてから対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録時点と期間使用量を照合した説明後に対応する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll separate the two dates, display, and usage, then act after hearing the correct record explained.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Act after an explanation comparing the recording times and period usage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当窓口へご案内します。請求書と写真をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll guide you to the relevant counter. Please bring the bill and photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お受け取りの商品は、まだ到着していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your collection item hasn't arrived yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二時の便と書いてあったので、今夜の二時に受け取れると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 午前二時の便を今日の夜の続きと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It said the two-o'clock service, so I came thinking I could collect it at two tonight.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you interpreted a two-a.m. service as the continuation of tonight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の日付も確認しましょう。午前二時は、どの日に指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the date on the information too. Which date specifies two a.m.?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明後日の日付です。今日の夜の続きだと思いましたが、もう一日後なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定日がもう一日後だと読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The day after tomorrow. I thought it meant the continuation of tonight, but it's another day later.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read back that the scheduled date is another day later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着予定と、受け取れる状態になった案内は別です。受取通知は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Scheduled arrival and notice that it's ready to collect are separate. Have you received a collection notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。便の予定だけで取りに来ました。通知を受けてから来る必要があるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取通知未着で予定だけを根拠に来たと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I came based only on the service schedule. I'd like to check whether I should come after receiving the notification.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say no collection notice has arrived and you came based only on the schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では、受け取り可能の通知後に番号を提示してください。夜中に来る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this situation, show the number after notification that collection is available. You don't need to come in the middle of the night.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では日付だけで急いで来ず、通知と受取期限を確認して、昼の時間に来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始通知と期限を確認して昼に来たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't hurry over based only on the date. I'd like to check the notification and collection deadline and come during the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the start notification and deadline and say you want to visit during daytime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知には受取期限も記載されます。期限内でご都合のよい時間をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The notification will also state the collection deadline. Check a convenient time within that deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。予定便と受取開始を混同せず、通知を待ってから番号と期限を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定便と受取可能状態を分け通知後に手続する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't confuse the scheduled service with the start of collection. I'll wait for the notice, then check the number and deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the scheduled service from readiness for collection and proceed after notification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品到着後の案内をご確認ください。今日は受け取りの受付は行いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the information after the item arrives. We won't process collection today.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はまとめてでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to pay together?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人で割りたいですが、一人は最後の飲み物だけです。注文人数が三人なら同じ額に分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参加人数と同額割勘を対応させてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: We'd like to split it among three, but one person only had the last drink. If three people ordered, can it be split equally?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the number of participants means an equal split is appropriate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店の会計方法と、お客様同士の負担の決め方は別です。注文した内容は明細で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: The shop's payment method and how you divide responsibility among yourselves are separate. You can check what was ordered on the itemized bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では均等にしたいと私だけが決めず、遅れて来た友人にも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 負担は全員で合意すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I won't decide an equal split by myself; I'll discuss it with the friend who came late too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide that everyone will agree on their share. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認用に明細をお渡しします。まだお支払いは始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll give you the details to check. We won't begin payment yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に二人で食べた料理と、後の飲み物を分けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先の料理と後の飲料を明細で区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'd like to view the dishes the two of us ate earlier separately from the later drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish earlier dishes and later drinks on the itemized bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに項目があります。店でそれぞれの負担を判断する話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: The items are here. The shop isn't deciding each person's share.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。店の明細を使って自分たちで合意します。料理を食べた人が一人減ったから、注文を一品消す依頼でもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内部負担調整が料理取消しではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We'll use the shop's details to agree ourselves. Having one fewer person eat the dishes also doesn't mean we're asking you to remove a dish from the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that adjusting shares within the group does not cancel food orders. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合意後のお支払い方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss the payment method after you've agreed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三人で話しました。会計は私が全額払い、友人から受け取る額は別に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全額一括払いと仲間内精算を分けて確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: The three of us have discussed it. I'll pay the entire bill, and we'll decide separately what I receive from my friends.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm full payment together separately from settlement among friends. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。全注文を含む金額で、まとめて会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll take a single payment for the amount including every order.
